message: test_visual_triage.test_build_cmd_unknown_tool_raises drops the result of pure tools.visual_triage.build_cmd - nothing it computes reaches an assertion
why: expected-raise test written with try/except plus an 'assert False' fallthrough: the call is asserted to raise ValueError, so its return value is dropped by design

message: test_audit_log.TestCircuitBreaker.test_cooldown_resets sleeps 0.15s - wall-clock waits make tests slow and flaky
why: the test deliberately configures cooldown=0.1 and sleeps 0.15: sleep can only overshoot so the assertion cannot flake, and 0.15s is cheaper than adding a clock seam to CircuitBreaker

message: test_autopilot_guard.TestAutopilotGuardCircuitBreaker.test_allow_after_cooldown sleeps 0.15s - wall-clock waits make tests slow and flaky
why: same shape: circuit_cooldown=0.1 is shrunk for the test and the 0.15s sleep is monotone, so the site is neither slow nor flaky and there is no condition to synchronize on but elapsed time itself

message: test_dashboard.TestDashboard.test_phase_done_auto_elapsed sleeps 0.01s - wall-clock waits make tests slow and flaky
why: _fmt_elapsed formats int(seconds) so it returns '0s' for a zero-length phase; the assertion elapsed != '' passes with the sleep deleted outright
